overview_description.description: Tenex is a real estate technology company that develops software for property management and building operations. Its platform includes tools for tenant experience, visitor management, maintenance coordination, and workplace services. The company works with commercial real estate operators to streamline communication and daily operational tasks across properties. It focuses on digitizing facility and tenant interaction processes through cloud-based solutions.

about_short_description.short_description: Tenex is a real estate technology platform that provides tools for property management, tenant engagement, and facility operations.

product.name: Property Management Solutions
product.description: A platform offering tools for managing properties, including tenant and landlord management, maintenance tracking, and contract renewals.

product.name: Real Estate Experience
product.description: A tenant engagement platform featuring communication tools, amenities booking, visitor management, and community-building features.

product.name: Facility and Asset Management
product.description: Tools for tracking maintenance, managing inventory, scheduling inspections, and maximizing asset lifespan.

product.name: Real Estate Accounting
product.description: A comprehensive accounting system tailored for real estate, including invoicing, budgeting, financial reporting, and VAT compliance.

product.name: Virtual Reality for Off-Plan Developments
product.description: A virtual reality platform that provides interactive 3D tours of off-plan properties to potential buyers remotely.

product.name: Hospitality Experience Pro
product.description: An all-in-one hotel management app offering mobile check-in, room keys, service bookings, real-time guest communication, and staff management.
